race.comment: GETAWAY (7) made an encouraging debut at Casterton, finishing second over 1000m when running on stoutly over the final stages. She should take significant improvement from that experience and looks ready to go one better. VILLA GRANDE (11) makes her debut for the Tom Dabernig stable and comes with plenty of jump-out experience under her belt, including a sharp recent effort here recently. Any market confidence would be worth following in. ENNISCRONE (3) resumes after four-and-a-half months off following a disappointing run at Stawell over 1600m. He will be more mature now and could be one to add to any top 4 combos in a modest field. NORTHERN GOLD (5) has had a jump-out since his last start and is not out of this. RUSSIAN INTO IT (6) resumes from a spell that would have done him the world of good. Each way here.
